entries.summary: Mirage retains an explicit CollectionView IsEnabled mapper entry so row interactivity updates deterministically when the host is disabled/enabled.
Mirage maps ItemSizingStrategy keys but currently keeps non-virtualized MeasureFirstItem behavior and emits deterministic diagnostics for unsupported sizing strategies.
Grouping keys are mapped for parity surface coverage, but grouped realization remains deferred; Mirage emits deterministic diagnostics and falls back to flat item realization.
CanReorderItems is mapped for parity governance, while browser reorder interaction remains deferred and is reported as deterministic unsupported behavior.
ItemsUpdatingScrollMode.KeepItemsInView currently falls back to KeepScrollOffset semantics with deterministic diagnostics until full anchoring parity is implemented.
